capabilities: export a note with its linked notes and attachments
follow note links recursively to a configurable depth
package the export as a single ZIP file
organize exported files by vault folders or by note headers
exclude folders or tags from the export
extras: README includes a short testing section with end-to-end (wdio) and unit tests; the author asks for donations via buy-me-a-coffee.
problem: Sharing a single Markdown file breaks its images, PDFs and links to other notes because the referenced files are left behind in the vault.
summary: Note exporter that collects a note together with its linked notes and attachments into a folder or ZIP file for sharing.
